newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-England A win toss and bat v South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-England A win toss and bat v South Australia.

text.p: England A captain Adam Hollioake won the toss and decided to bat at the start of a four-day match against South Australia at Adelaide Oval on Friday.

The match is the third for the England side on their current tour of Australia. England A beat South Australia in a limited overs match on Wednesday but were convincingly beaten by a New South Wales second XI in a four-day match last week.
England A - Mark Butcher, Michael Vaughan, Anthony McGrath, Owais Shah, Adam Hollioake (captain), Craig White, Mark Ealham, Warren Hegg, Ashley Giles, Andrew Harris, Dean Headley.
South Australia - Greg Blewett, Ben Johnson, Jamie Siddons (captain), Darren Lehmann, James Brayshaw, Joe Scuderi, Tim Nielsen, Brad Young, Jason Gillespie, Peter McIntyre, Mark Harrity.
